name: Pop-Up by Patina
wheelchair:description: Genies Café is tucked away down a long ramp. It is a spacious area that has a wide entrance door and even flooring. There is an accessible toilet in the next building, approx. 30 metres away. Emergency telephone located nearby, however is not accessible.

alt_name: Dorothy Hill Physical Sciences and Engineering Library
name: Dorothy Hill Engineering and Sciences Library
wheelchair:description: Wheelchair accessible parking,entrance,information counter,lift and toilet. Single parking lot is too small. Ramp from parking lacks landing at 9-metre mark. Narrow ramp between library security gates;lacks handrails. Toilet lock is hard to reach.

name: Biological Sciences Library
wheelchair:description: 3 accessible car bays. Paths to entry: road crossings and ramp. No threshold, automatic door. Lift access to all levels. Small wheel-under room at tables. 1 height adjustable desk and accessible toilet on each level. Limited room on 3rd & 4th levels.

name: Central Library
wheelchair:description: Main entrance is accessible with ramps and automatic doors. Clear continuous travel path within building with accessible lift. Level two has a unisex accessible toilet with limited circulation space and no emergency button. Signage in building is limited.

name: Fryer Library
wheelchair:description: Fryer library is wheelchair accessible. Has a ramp at the front entrance and an accessible lift. A step-free unisex accessible toilet is provided but no emergency button. Four disabled parking bays but length are short, which could make parking difficult.

name: Australia Post St Lucia Post Shop
Saint Lucy Caffé e Cucina
wheelchair:description: The main section of café is wheelchair accessible and tables are a user-friendly height. Disabled parking is 350m away and disabled toilet 30m from café, both are accessible by a concrete pathway. Service counter is high but accessible with difficulty.

name: Darwin's
wheelchair:description: Darwins is wheelchair accessible with a clear path to the counter through an automatic sliding glass door. The counter is too high however and makes ordering difficult.

name: UQ Union Physiol Eatery & Cafe
wheelchair:description: Path from closest car park to Physiology Refectory is steep & lacks landings. Refectory service counter is high - difficult to order/collect food. Entrance & path in/around Refectory is accessible. Accessible unisex, spacious toilet close to Refectory.

The fountain is at an appropriate height and allows wheelchair users to wheel under the fountain. Requires forceful pressing of button to operate. Also has side fountains for water bottles, however not at an appropriate height.

comment: Outside alternate entrance of level 2 of Axon Building
wheelchair:description: Water fountain located at top of ramp via service road off Staff House road; outside level 2 entrance to Axon building. Fountain inaccessible from wheelchair height. Water bottle filler available and accessible. No signage to indicate location.

Drink outlet is accessible, however the slot through which the individual pays is quite high, and is hard to access from a wheelchair. No space for the wheelchair to fit under, so the individual must reach forward to use the vending machine.

Two water fountains on every floor. Short fountain does not have space underneath for wheelchair to wheel in. Tall fountain is at appropriate height and allows wheelchair to pull in. However, depending on height of person, may be difficult to lean in.

description: Delivery/carryout chain offering a wide range of pizza, plus chicken & other sides.

name: David Theile Olympic Pool
wheelchair:description: The parking was accessible with 2 disabled parks. The entrance path was independently accessible. The service counter is high and had no wheel-under space. The complex has 2 disabled toilets. Accessible paths of travel within the premises.

designation: UQ Union Main Course Food Precinct
name: UQ Union Main Course Food Precinct
wheelchair:description: An internal entryway is very narrow and may impede access for some wheelchairs, but a door on the right side of the building can bypass this. Toilets meet Wheelmap accessibility standards, but pipes under the sink do not comply with Australian Standards.

name: UQ Sport Fitness Centre
wheelchair:description: Accessibility to ground floor only. No lifts to toilets or weight rooms. Nearest accessible unisex toilet is across the street. Automated services are too high. Parking close to entrance but difficult to get to independently.
